description: UI balancing domain (D-10), REPLAN nested tree (Phase 9A): UI timing plus FX/art tunables (the REPLAN folds FX into ui - no separate vfx domain). Values are the prototype's live tuning, verbatim. Bounds policy: seconds 0-60, pixels -4096-4096.

Debug.description: Developer/debug visibility toggles. Off by default in shipped data.

show_camera_startpoint.description: If true the camera-startpoint marker sprite is drawn in the running game (grey-X placeholder until art is imported). Default false: the game uses the startpoint only to position the camera and draws nothing for it. Always visible in the editor regardless.

FX.description: Visual FX and background art tunables.

bg_art.description: The hand-painted background art layer under the tile grid.

enabled.description: If true the background art layer draws (canonical flag; was BG_ART_ENABLED + FEATURE_BG_ART).

file.description: Background image filename (resolved against the game's art directory).

offset_x.description: Horizontal offset of the background in world pixels.

offset_y.description: Vertical offset of the background in world pixels.

world_h.description: Background height in world pixels at zoom 1.

world_w.description: Background width in world pixels at zoom 1.

enabled.description: If true the boss announcement banner plays on boss rounds (canonical flag; was FEATURE_BOSS_ANNOUNCEMENT).

hold.description: Banner hold seconds at full opacity.

gore_enabled.description: Master gore toggle: blood splatters and stains (canonical flag; was GORE_ENABLED + FEATURE_BLOOD_STAINS). Also user-facing via the settings menu.

income_floaters_enabled.description: If true income/upkeep floater numbers rise from buildings during the income phase (canonical flag; was FEATURE_INCOME_FLOATERS).

Menu.description: Top-level shell/menu tunables (Phase 9H): the intro-cutscene timing.

cutscene_length.description: Seconds the intro cutscene plays before it auto-advances to the main menu (prototype cutscene.py length cap; the decoder running out ends it sooner).

Timing.description: UI interaction timing and layout toggles.

confirm_on_right_side.description: If true the confirm button sits on the right side of the construct preview.

construct_show_cancel.description: If true the construct preview shows a cancel button next to confirm.

not_enough_love_duration.description: Seconds the 'not enough love' flash stays on screen.

_lock.description: Branch+lock protocol state (D-11): the literal string UNLOCKED, or {locked_by, since} while a feature<Domain> branch exists. Set by /start-domain and cleared ONLY by /merge-domain (Phase 8, T-1) - never by the editor.

title: ui
